title: How to Shorten a Link in Google Docs: The Best Tool for Internal Teams
summary: Learn how to shorten a link in Google Docs with GoLinks — the secure URL shortener that creates memorable short links for internal teams.
body_markdown:
If you’ve ever pasted a sprawling Google Docs URL into a team chat, an email, or another document, you already know the problem: long links are ugly, hard to remember, and nearly impossible to share verbally. For teams that keep onboarding guides, SOPs, style guides, and knowledge bases in Google Docs, short links make those resources easier to find and share.


**A go link is a short, memorable internal URL — like` go/onboarding` or` go/brand-guide` — that redirects anyone on your team to any destination you set.**


This guide covers the fastest, most team-friendly way to shorten a link in Google Docs, including a step-by-step walkthrough and answers to common questions.


## **What Is the Best Way to Shorten a Link in Google Docs?**


The best way to shorten a link in Google Docs is to use GoLinks, a team-focused URL shortener. Install the GoLinks Chrome extension, paste your long URL, generate a short “go link,” and insert it directly into your Google Doc. Unlike public shorteners or discontinued tools like Google’s own URL shortener (goo.gl), GoLinks lets teams save, organize, and share links securely.


## **Why You Need a Link Shortener for Google Docs**


Long URLs buried inside Google Docs create friction — especially in onboarding guides, style guides, wikis, and other frequently shared internal documents. A good short link is easier to read, easier to remember, and can even be shared verbally in a meeting or Slack huddle without anyone scrambling to type a 90-character URL. And the[benefits of using a URL shortener](https://www.golinks.com/blog/5-reasons-why-you-should-use-a-url-shortener/) go beyond convenience — the right tool also improves analytics visibility, strengthens security, and makes internal knowledge easier to find at scale.


The need has only grown since Google retired its URL shortener, goo.gl. Google blocked new users from creating links in April 2018 and ended link creation for everyone on March 30, 2019. In August 2025, Google deactivated inactive goo.gl links but[kept actively used ones working](https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/technology/developers-tools/googl-link-shortening-update/) . Teams now have no native way to create new short links. Public tools like Bitly fill the gap for personal use, but they weren’t built for internal teams. They lack the access controls and organization features that company documentation demands.

Instead of copying and pasting long, unwieldy URLs, your team gets short, memorable go links — like go/onboarding or go/brand-guide — that anyone can type directly into a browser, drop into a Slack message, or say out loud in a meeting.

## **How to Shorten a Link in Google Docs: Step-by-Step**


Follow these steps to create a short link inside any Google Doc using the GoLinks Chrome extension:


**Before you start:**[Sign up for a free GoLinks account](https://www.golinks.io/) and[install the GoLinks Chrome extension](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/golinks/mdkgfdijbhbcbajcdlebbodoppgnmhab) .


1. **Copy your Google Doc’s URL.** Open the doc in Chrome and copy the full` https://docs.google.com/…` address from the address bar.
2. **Open the GoLinks extension.** Click the GoLinks icon in your browser toolbar.
3. **Paste the URL.** Drop it into the Destination URL field.
4. **Name your go link.** Choose a short, memorable name like go/q3-report or go/brand-guide. Add tags and a description if you want.
5. **Create and insert the link.** Click Create, copy the go link, and paste it into your Google Doc.
6. **Share it anywhere.** Drop it in Slack, say it aloud in a meeting, or type it into any browser.


**Pro tip:** Name go links the way your team talks. If people say “the brand guide,” use go/brand-guide. Names people can guess get used. Names they have to look up don’t.

## **Frequently Asked Questions About Shortening Links in Google Docs**


**Can you shorten a Google Docs URL without a tool?**


Partially. Delete everything after the document ID (for example,` /edit?usp=sharing` ) and the link still opens the doc. The URL stays long and unreadable, though. For a short, memorable link, use a go link.


**Can you shorten a link directly in Google Docs?**


Google Docs does not have a built-in link shortener. The best way to shorten a link in Google Docs is to use a third-party tool like GoLinks, which integrates directly via a[Chrome extension](https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/golinks/mdkgfdijbhbcbajcdlebbodoppgnmhab) and[Google Docs add-on](https://workspace.google.com/marketplace/app/golinks_for_google_docs/360435649280) .


****Does Google still offer a URL shortener?****


No. Google announced in March 2018 that it would wind down goo.gl, citing changes in how people find content online. Link creation ended for all users on March 30, 2019. On August 25, 2025, Google deactivated goo.gl links that showed no activity in late 2024. Actively used links still redirect, but no one can create new ones. Teams that need short links now rely on third-party tools like GoLinks.


****What is the best link shortener for Google Docs?****


GoLinks is the best link shortener for Google Docs. It integrates via a Chrome extension and Google Docs add-on, offers a free plan, and is designed specifically for internal teams — not just public sharing.


****Is Bitly safe to use in internal Google Docs?****


Bitly is a public tool not designed for internal documentation. It lacks enterprise-grade permissions, team management, and organizational access controls. For internal Google Docs, GoLinks is a more secure and better-organized alternative.


****How do I create a short link for a Google Drive file?****


Install the GoLinks Chrome extension, open the Google Drive file, copy its URL, click the GoLinks extension icon, paste the URL, name your go link, and insert it wherever you need it — including directly in a Google Doc.


****Can I share a GoLink verbally?****


Yes — and that’s one of GoLinks’ biggest advantages over standard link shorteners. Links like go/budget-2027 can be spoken aloud in meetings, Zoom calls, or Slack huddles without anyone needing to type or copy a long URL.
